uri.description: LDAP server URI(s) — space-separated for failover (e.g., 'ldap://ldap1.example.com ldap://ldap2.example.com')

base_dn.description: Default base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., 'dc=myorg,dc=local')

ldap_version.description: LDAP protocol version to use (1, 2, or 3); typically 3

timelimit.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a server connection; 0 means unlimited

sizelimit.description: Maximum number of entries to return from a search; 0 means unlimited

tls_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification

sasl_enabled.description: Enable SASL authentication (e.g., GSSAPI for Kerberos)

sasl_mech.description: SASL mechanism to use when SASL is enabled

sasl_realm.description: SASL realm (Kerberos realm for GSSAPI); leave empty to auto-detect

sasl_authcid.description: SASL authentication identity (e.g., principal name for GSSAPI)

referrals.description: How to handle referrals: 'follow' (automatically chase), 'stop' (do not chase)

bind_dn.description: Default bind DN for client tools (e.g., 'cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com'); leave empty to bind anonymously

bind_pw.description: Password for default bind DN. If empty, tools will prompt interactively. Not stored in config for security.

extra_options.description: Additional configuration key-value pairs (for advanced or vendor-specific options)

comment.description: Optional human-readable note for the line
